title: An LLM-Driven Traffic-Control xApp for Dynamic 5G RAN Intents
abstract: arXiv:2611.25736v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Programmable Radio Access Networks (RANs) enable runtime deployment of traffic-control functions, but selecting the appropriate configuration remains challenging as network conditions and service requirements change over time. Conventional solutions often rely on static rules or learning-based controllers with predefined state and action spaces, limiting their ability to accommodate changing intents. This paper introduces an LLM-driven xApp for traffic control in programmable RANs. The proposed architecture combines operator-defined service intents, runtime E2 interface telemetry, and the currently deployed configuration to generate traffic-management policies without blocking packet forwarding or the processing of incoming E2 measurements during LLM inference. translated_title: 一种面向动态5G RAN意图的LLM驱动流量控制xApp
translated_abstract: 可编程无线接入网（RAN）支持在运行时部署流量控制功能，但随着网络条件和服务需求随时间变化，如何选择合适的配置仍然具有挑战性。传统解决方案通常依赖静态规则或具有预定义状态和动作空间的学习型控制器，限制了其适应不断变化的意图的能力。本文介绍了一种用于可编程RAN流量控制的LLM驱动的xApp。所提出的架构结合了运营商定义的服务意图、运行时E2接口遥测数据以及当前部署的配置，在LLM推理期间不会阻塞数据包转发或传入E2测量的处理，从而生成流量管理策略。在OpenAirInterface 5G环境上的实验表明，所提出的控制器能够动态调整流量控制流水线以适应运行时的意图变化，平均……
tldr: 本文提出了一种由大语言模型驱动的xApp，能够在不阻塞数据包转发和E2测量处理的情况下，结合运营商服务意图与实时遥测数据，动态生成并调整5G可编程无线接入网的流量控制策略。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an LLM-driven xApp that dynamically generates and adapts traffic-control policies for programmable 5G RANs based on operator-defined intents and runtime telemetry, without blocking packet forwarding or E2 measurement processing during LLM inference.
